description: Get sleep data (stages, score, HRV, breathing) for a day, or for each day from date to endDate in one call. The chart shows the days ending at the last requested date.

date.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (the first day when endDate is given)

endDate.description: Optional last day (YYYY-MM-DD, max 14 days) to get every day in the range in ONE call. Prefer this over calling the tool once per day: each call shows its own chart.

name: get-sleep
title: Get Sleep
